decisions.reason: Because the illuminated candle arch with sound is close to the firm's established wooden arch and candleholder craft, the firm has strong absorptive capacity to learn from market feedback and improve it, so it is unlikely to be dropped.
The arched one-tier pyramid directly builds on the firm's core pyramid-making knowledge, enabling easy assimilation of early results and low drop probability.

Although the electronic music box is a flagship line, it is distant from the firm's handcrafted wood knowledge, limiting its ability to interpret and improve the product, so it faces a higher risk of being dropped.
The motif platform for electronic music box is also distant from the woodcraft base and offers less strategic focus, so low absorptive capacity makes it more likely to be dropped.
Like other electronic music box accessories, this Christmas platform relies on unrelated electronic knowledge, reducing the firm's ability to learn and improve, hence a high drop probability.
The Dresden-themed Christmas pyramid builds directly on the firm's established pyramid craft, ensuring high absorptive capacity and a very low probability of being dropped.
